# ThumbmarkJS vendored dependency

- Package: `@thumbmarkjs/thumbmarkjs`
- Version: `1.10.1`
- Upstream repository: <https://github.com/thumbmarkjs/thumbmarkjs>
- Upstream commit: `97f48064bb3e1932c4faf7a5a291b05763469fe8`
- Registry archive: `thumbmarkjs-thumbmarkjs-1.10.1.tgz`
- License: MIT (see `1.10.1/LICENSE`)

The checked-in registry archive is the application dependency used by
`apps/web/package.json`. The extracted `1.10.1` directory is retained as an
auditable source snapshot. Builds therefore do not need the upstream package
or repository to remain available.

To update this dependency, review the upstream release and license, replace
both the archive and extracted snapshot, update the checksum and metadata in
this file, then rebuild both public runtimes and run the web/API test suites.
